purpose: Teach: ユリ/蟻/死神/邦楽/半径/オゾン/ダシ/漢文

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがユリの絵を描いてあげる
lines.en: Sho, I'll draw a lily for you.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Soft voice pitched toward a child. Slight smile in the delivery—offering something small and genuine. Slow, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お庭で蟻の行列を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a line of ants in the garden today.
lines.style: Quiet, careful attention. Small voice but steady. Slight pause after the observation, as if sharing something he noticed and wants her to understand matters. Not seeking approval, just sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本で死神のキャラを描く時は気を付けてね
lines.en: Sho, when you draw characters like the Grim Reaper in picture books, be thoughtful about it, okay?
lines.style: Gentle caution without alarm. Speaking as someone who cares what he creates. Soft but clear—not lecturing, just guiding. Slight warmth under the instruction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、邦楽のCDを聴いてみたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to listen to some Japanese music CDs.
lines.style: Small eager voice with genuine curiosity. The word 'want' lands with a soft wish in it—not demanding, just hoping. Slightly lifted at the end, inviting her into his interest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、円の半径を求める算数の問題できたわね
lines.en: Sho, you solved that math problem about finding the radius of a circle.
lines.style: Quiet pride in him. Gentle affirmation—noticing and naming something he did well. Warm tone, no condescension. The recognition of someone who sees his effort.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、理科でオゾン層のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, we learned about the ozone layer in science today.
lines.style: Earnest report from a child sharing what he's learning. Careful enunciation, like the words matter to him. Small but clear voice, proud to know something new.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがダシを取って下さるおうどん大好きね
lines.en: Sho, you love Grandma's udon with the dashi she makes from scratch, don't you?
lines.style: Warm, knowing observation. Soft smile in the voice. Lingering slightly on 'dashi,' savoring the care in it. Tender without being saccharine—just noticing something he holds dear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんから漢文の本もらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad gave me a book of classical Chinese poetry.
lines.style: Quiet pride, carefully controlled. Small voice but steady—this matters to him. Slight lift at the end, as if hoping she'll understand why he's telling her. The contentment of something meaningful received.
